    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]

        for c in range(w)

        sep = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

            gaps = [b-a for a, b in zip(positions, positions[1:])]
            step = Counter(gaps).most_common(1)[0][0]
            positions = [p for p in positions
                         if (p - positions[0]) % step == 0]
        return positions, sep

    rows, rsep = line_positions(row_modes)

    # Fill is the prevalent non-separator tile color.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    if fill in (rsep, csep):
        alternatives = [v for v in counts if v not in (rsep, csep)]
        if alternatives:
            fill = max(alternatives, key=lambda v: counts[v])

    # Horizontal marker bands between the outer boundaries, sampled at each
    # vertical lattice line except the final boundary.
    sample_rows = rows[1:-1] if len(rows) > 2 else rows
    sample_cols = cols[:-1]
    if not sample_rows or not sample_cols:
        return [[fill]]

    out = []
    for r in sample_rows:
        out.append([
            grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] not in (rsep, csep) else fill
            for c in sample_cols
        ])
